subject.title: Manual context clearing for tool results

question: Should OpenClaw add caller-directed tool-result clearing as destructive transcript rewrite, model-context-only masking, or recoverable archival, and which adapters should expose that contract?
rationale: The request changes core session lifecycle semantics across persistence, replay, compaction, authorization, and agent control, so automation should not choose the product and safety model.

options.title: Design Canonical Archive/Clear Contract
options.body: Define stable ids, auth, persistence, recovery, and replay semantics first, then add CLI or agent-facing adapters over that single operation.

options.title: Keep Automatic Pruning Only
options.body: Decline manual clearing for now and improve docs or heuristics around TTL, truncation, compact, new-session, and reset workflows.

options.title: Implement Narrow Destructive Clear
options.body: Add only a targeted clear-by-id operation, accepting minimal recovery and audit semantics as an explicit product tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Design Canonical Archive/Clear Contract
recommendation.body: Define stable ids, auth, persistence, recovery, and replay semantics first, then add CLI or agent-facing adapters over that single operation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored cache-TTL pruning and was already identified in the prior review as the strongest adjacent product reviewer for this issue family.
